sources.title: Immigrants requiring visas to enter the Kingdom of Swaziland
sources.publisher: Government of the Kingdom of Eswatini / Ministry of Home Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live .gov.sz Home Affairs visitor page carries the Government of the Kingdom of Eswatini copyright and publishes the Y/N country table together with visitor-visa processing information.

sources.title: Immigrants not requiring visas to enter the Kingdom of Swaziland
sources.publisher: Government of the Kingdom of Eswatini
sources.officialityEvidence: The live .gov.sz Government page is expressly headed as the visa-free list and names individual countries; it carries the Government of the Kingdom of Eswatini copyright.

sources.title: Visa: proposed pre-departure issuance guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs, Kingdom of Eswatini
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry of Home Affairs service page retains a proposal to suspend visa-on-arrival issuance and affix visas before departure; it is not treated as an unqualified operative timing rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: It is proposed that all people intending to enter the country visas would be issued and affixed to a passport before departing

sources.title: Serbian MFA: Eswatini travel and visa regime
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Serbian MFA destination page is headed Eswatini and separately states the regular-passport visa regime, entry passport validity and the non-resident Serbian mission responsible for Eswatini.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Obični pasoši i druge putne isprave: Viza nije potrebna

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Eswatini visa-free visits
policies.summary: Serbia's current Foreign Ministry Eswatini guidance expressly says ordinary Serbian passports do not require a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Serbian passport for a short visitor trip; the source does not publish a visitor-stay duration.
The passport must be valid for six months from intended entry and have two blank pages.
Diplomatic, official, travel-document, residence, work, study, transit and final-admission circumstances are outside this baseline.

conflicts.explanation: The current required-visa table gives the Republic of Korea N but separately gives South Korea Y, while the current visa-free list names Republic of Korea. Those incompatible direct official entries cannot yield one ordinary-passport baseline.

The current required-visa table gives China N and People’s Republic of China Y, while the current visa-free list names China. These incompatible direct official entries cannot yield one ordinary-passport baseline.

The country table directly marks DRC visa-required, but the live service guidance does not establish actual issuance timing: it describes Ministry or mission applications while treating pre-departure affixing only as a proposal.

unresolved.reason: Eswatini’s current official materials directly conflict: the required-visa page has Republic of Korea N and South Korea Y, while the visa-free page names Republic of Korea. No ordinary-passport baseline is selected.

Kosovo is not directly named in Eswatini’s current country lists. No current Eswatini or Kosovan authority establishes ordinary-passport recognition or visitor issuance timing; no omission or complement inference is made.

Eswatini’s current official materials directly conflict: the required-visa table has China N and People’s Republic of China Y, while the visa-free page names China. No ordinary-passport baseline is selected.
